feature_contracts.description: MMIO write to CTRL enables the controller through the real MMIO register map.
MMIO write to TARGET_SPEED_MPS updates the firmware-visible target speed semantic field.
MMIO write to TIMEOUT_CYCLES updates the controller timeout semantic field.
When enabled and the external model handshake is ready, the controller emits a model request through the required transport outputs.

top_module.name: adaptive_aero_control_top
top_module.description: Top-level integration for firmware-visible MMIO, external model transport, control/safety logic, and bulk history storage. It exposes the required synthesizable top, instantiates the register map, model transport adapter, control core, and history store wrapper, and preserves bounded control behavior without fallback substitution.
top_module.functionality: Integrates firmware MMIO control, model transport, control/safety, and memory-backed history storage. It forwards firmware configuration into semantic control fields, transfers model request and response traffic with mandatory transport polarity, produces bounded actuator commands when data is valid and fresh, and exposes fault/status readback while inhibiting actuation on invalid, stale, timeout, reset, or fault conditions.
responsibilities: Provide the synthesizable top-level integration point requested by firmware and hardware.
Decode MMIO writes and reads into implemented registers and fields.
Emit model-request valid/data as outputs and receive model-request ready as an input.
Receive model-response valid/data as inputs and emit model-response ready as an output.
Generate bounded actuator commands only when inputs are valid and fresh.
Deassert actuator command validity on invalid, stale, timeout, reset, or fault conditions.
Latch faults for software visibility instead of silently substituting fallback commands.
Instantiate and use the declared SRAM macro for history/payload storage.
top_module.reset_behavior: On reset, the top deasserts mmio_ready, mmio_rvalid, req_valid, rsp_ready, actuator_cmd_valid, status_valid, and fault_latched; drives output data buses to benign values; and clears control state to a safe inhibited baseline without asserting any fallback command.
behavior_rules: All firmware-visible configuration and status must be reachable through the declared MMIO bus.
The top must not expose inaccessible internal state as software-visible registers.
Bulk history storage must be implemented through the declared SRAM macro path and not flattened into discrete registers.
External model transport direction must follow the mandatory contract regardless of naming.
If input validity, response freshness, timeout, range checks, or fault checks fail, actuator_cmd_valid must deassert and fault_latched must assert or remain asserted.
Actuator command data must remain bounded for the intended operating range and must not be replaced with a fallback command on fault.
Firmware-visible status shall be provided through status_valid/status_data and MMIO readback.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_register_map
modules.description: Firmware-visible CSR/MMIO decode and register file for control, status, limits, timeout, and history control fields.
modules.functionality: Decodes the firmware-visible MMIO interface into writable configuration and readable status registers. Exposes semantic control fields for enable, target speed, command slew bound, timeout, and fault clear, and returns controller status and fault state through readback.
responsibilities: Decode writes into final semantic configuration fields.
Return read data for implemented registers and fields.
Provide software-visible control of enable, target speed, command limits, timeout, and fault clear.
Expose status and latched fault state for firmware.
Keep inaccessible internal state out of the software contract.
modules.reset_behavior: Returns MMIO handshake outputs to inactive states and clears writable configuration fields to safe inhibited defaults.
behavior_rules: Each semantic configuration field must be fully decoded from MMIO writes and be visible as a real output port.
MMIO reads must return the implemented status and configuration values only for defined registers.
Fault clear is a one-cycle control pulse or equivalent write-side semantic field; it must not directly invent a fallback command.
This module must not consume raw transport buses in place of semantic control fields.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_model_transport
modules.description: External model request/response transport adapter that emits request valid/data, accepts request ready, accepts response valid/data, and emits response ready while buffering the current model transaction state.
modules.functionality: Manages the external model transport handshake and buffers request/response activity for the controller. It presents request valid/data as outputs and response ready as an output, while receiving request ready and response valid/data as inputs, matching the mandatory direction contract.
responsibilities: Drive model-request valid/data outputs.
Receive model-request ready as an input.
Receive model-response valid/data as inputs.
Drive model-response ready as an output.
Bridge the controller's semantic request/response flow to the external transport contract.
Maintain handshake correctness without substituting a fallback response path.
modules.reset_behavior: Deasserts both request and response transport activity and clears buffered transport state to idle.
behavior_rules: The module must not reverse the mandated transport direction.
The top-level request output must have a real RTL driver.
The top-level response-ready output must be actively driven by RTL.
Transport signals must remain distinct from firmware MMIO signals.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_control_core
modules.description: Control, validation, timeout, bounded-command, and safety core for active-aerodynamics actuation.
modules.functionality: Computes bounded actuator commands from validated model data and operating inputs, enforces stale-data and timeout detection, latches faults, and emits a status word reflecting controller state. It also records control history records for bulk storage.
responsibilities: Validate model availability and freshness.
Bound actuator command updates according to configured slew and operating constraints.
Generate actuator command validity only when the command is valid.
Latch fault indication when enable is inactive, data is stale, timeout occurs, or validation fails.
Provide status word for firmware/MMIO readback.
Generate history store accesses for bulk payload/history logging.
modules.reset_behavior: Clears command and status outputs to safe inhibited values and deasserts history access outputs until enabled.
behavior_rules: No fallback command, fallback register, or fallback-on-reset behavior is allowed.
On invalid, stale, timeout, reset, or fault conditions, actuator_cmd_valid must be deasserted.
Actuator command data must remain within the configured bounded actuation range.
Status must summarize observable controller state only through declared outputs.
Bulk history accesses must use the declared memory wrapper path and not a register flattening substitute.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_history_store
modules.description: Bulk storage wrapper for history, payload, and FIFO-like records implemented with a technology-neutral SRAM macro mapping to block RAM or equivalent native memory.
modules.functionality: Stores payload, history, and FIFO-like records in a wrapper around the declared SRAM macro. The wrapper controls the technology-neutral memory interface and exposes read data to the control fabric without flattening bulk storage into registers.
responsibilities: Drive the memory macro interface.
Provide storage for telemetry/history/payload records.
Expose read data to the controller datapath.
Avoid register-array substitution for bulk storage.
modules.reset_behavior: Resets memory control outputs to inactive states. The macro contents are not implicitly overwritten by reset; storage validity is tracked separately by controller logic.
behavior_rules: The wrapper must instantiate the declared SRAM macro by name and instance_name contract.
Bulk payload/history/FIFO storage is not represented as flops or a flattened register bank.
Read data from the macro must be consumed and forwarded to store_rdata.
Write and read accesses follow the macro protocol and may be mapped to native block RAM by the FPGA flow.

Active-low reset fanout to all submodules.

Firmware write-enable input into the MMIO register map.

MMIO read data output driven by the register map.
MMIO read-valid output driven by the register map.

External model request data output driven by the transport adapter.
